admission.justification: Prevents unrelated SSE task deltas from aborting and refiring /saved-catalog, /options, and /result on every task event while DocumentChat is open; proved by DocumentChat.test.tsx.

applicability: Operations right-rail bound DocumentChat launcher while SSE task deltas update the task list.
conditions: The bound selection's role and canonical document references are unchanged.
useRoleChatOptionsLoader keys its effect on Boolean(boundSelection) rather than boundSelection object identity.
exclusions: Changing the selected role or canonical document references still aborts superseded reads and loads the new scope.
statement: A bound DocumentChat selection with unchanged role and document references keeps its active launcher reads.
title: Bound DocumentChat keeps active launcher reads across equal-scope task deltas
